title: Upside-Down Swing
coreRelationships: The subject's body forms a dynamic diagonal line against the static sky.
The bright pink dress and white collar/socks contrast sharply with the muted blue sky and the subject's dark hair.
The swing chains create leading lines that draw the eye towards the subject's hands.
The upside-down orientation of the subject creates a sense of disorientation and playfulness.
